fusions.name: Bulldozing Advance
fusions.desc: Drives your shield into an enemy up to 4 tiles away, dealing 14 damage and knocking it 3.5 tiles back.

fusions.name: Hurled Bulwark
fusions.desc: Hurls your shield with everything you have, dealing 32 damage to the first enemy it meets and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Full Heave
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Pent Force
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you deal 4% more damage per stack (29% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
